# PlayerBatch Studio

> PlayerBatch Studio is a local Windows batch-production tool for sports Media Day photographers. It turns one roster CSV and a portrait folder into consistent athlete graphics at roster scale.

## Current release
- Version: V2.2.1
- Platform: Windows
- License model: one-time purchase
- Processing: local
- Photoshop: not required
- Paid API: not required for the current release

## Product workflow
- Inputs: roster CSV plus PNG/JPG athlete portraits
- Matching: roster-to-portrait matching with exception review
- Background removal: automatic local background removal
- Outputs: 1080x1350 social PNGs and 2400x3000 print PNGs
- Delivery: ZIP export with manifest and failure reporting
- Visual systems: Arena Depth, Impact Editorial, Team Studio, Game Tunnel
- Intended job size: roster-scale sports jobs, roughly 20-100 athletes

## Scope
PlayerBatch Studio does not replace RAW ingest, photo culling, Lightroom-style color correction, client galleries, ordering, lab fulfillment, or game-action photo delivery. It is focused on roster-driven Media Day graphics production after portrait selection.
